title: (huntress.com) Compiling Cryptominers On-Endpoint: A Novel Approach Leveraging Samsung MagicINFO Vulnerabilities and SilentXMRMiner In brief
content_md:
(huntress.com) Compiling Cryptominers On-Endpoint: A Novel Approach Leveraging Samsung MagicINFO Vulnerabilities and SilentXMRMiner In brief

via Mastodon https://www.huntress.com/blog/threat-actor-compiles-cryptominer

CVE-2025-4632.evidence: Huntress IR observed a threat actor exploit the Samsung MagicINFO flaw to install AnyDesk, create a local admin account, and compile the SilentXMRMiner on the compromised endpoint.
